objective: Bring 8 crates of Milly's Harvest to Milly Osworth at Northshire Abbey.

description: A gang of brigands, the Defias, moved into the Northshire Vineyards while I was harvesting!  I reported it to the Northshire guards and they assured me they'd take care of things, but... I'm afraid for my crop of grapes!  If the Defias don't steal them then I fear our guards will trample them when they chase away the thugs.
Please, you must help me!  I gathered most of my grapes into buckets, but I left them in the vineyards to the southeast.
Bring me those buckets!  Save my harvest!
completion: Oh thank you, <name>! You saved my harvest! And I hope you showed a few of those Defias that they can't cause trouble around here.
We might be short on guards these days, but we're lucky to have heroes like you to protect us!
